what_happened.line: The Public Access Cable Committee approved two sets of prior meeting minutes; the vote counts were not audible on the recording.
The manager's monthly report covered shows, equipment, staff listening sessions and finances; members noted interest on the cable account was missing from the manager's sheet.
The program analysis showed local programming running below last year's pace.
Members discussed the town master plan steering committee and left the item on the agenda; one member criticized consulting spending while the committee has not met for a year.
The quarterly report showed the treasury bond investment account grew from its original investment, with interest reinvested; the next meeting was set for December 2nd.

why_it_matters: The committee oversees the town's cable access account, so a missing interest posting on the manager's sheet affects whether the account's balance is recorded completely.
Master plan survey spending and a steering committee that has not met touch how town planning money is used, a question residents may be asked about at budget time.
